text:
encops-bot: :rotating_light: Restore fail cluster: tenant-99 (rst=2026-03-22-99) error=InvalidCiphertextException from KMS

noah: noticed several restores failing since 03:05 UTC, right after CMK rotation. anyone triaging?

iris: quick head-object shows metadata pointing at old CMK id. seems uploads before rotation still reference old key.

sanjay: rotation job pruned legacy grants; trying to create grant now but KMS returns NotAuthorized. key policy tightened as part of rotation.

oncall: customer impact? estimate 3 restores failed, 1 customer blocked. classify P2.

encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-99 opened.

maya: short-term: A) temp widen key policy to allow infra-create-grant B) rewrap objects C) serve from backups in other region if grants exist. A fastest.

iris: drafting 1-hour scoped key policy rollback and tagging sec-approvers. will add audit note and revert plan.

sanjay: CloudTrail shows several Decrypt AccessDenied and InvalidCiphertext within minutes of rotation. sequence bug: grants removed before policy allowed recreate.

oncall: sec approved emergency window. iris applied change and created grant at 03:20 UTC. test restore succeeded at 03:33 UTC. Incident mitigated but follow-ups required.

maya: follow-ups: update rotation playbook to recreate grants before prune, add CI smoke that tries a canary restore post-rotation, schedule rewrap job for pre-rotation snapshots older than 60 days.

noah: mark as procedural risk for postmortem. include PR diffs and timeline. close thread after PMR published.
